description:
■What is Merge Kitchen?
Merge Kitchen is a merging puzzle & tower defense game.
Combine ingredients and monsters to wipe out the royal soldiers who try to attack Maoh, the devil.

＼＼Play the whole game for free! ／／

(…In-app purchase available to remove ads...)
(Thank you for your cooperation!)

■How to play

1: Create monsters
Monsters are created by swiping and combining the same ingredients on the puzzle.
Quickly find matches and swipe to create monsters.

2: Monsters appear
Monsters are created in Maoh’s pot.
Hold the monsters and swipe them out of the puzzle. Monsters will jump out of the pot and start attacking the enemies.

3: Monsters evolve
Monsters can evolve up to 2 levels by combining the same monsters or using the potion on a monster.
Monsters become more powerful as they evolve, so try combining them based on the ingredients available.
*You will need to obtain a recipe to combine the same monsters.

4: Game Clear & Game Over
Defeat the enemy with the crown mark to clear the game.
The game is over when Maoh’s pot is destroyed by the royal soldiers.

5: Strengthen Maoh and the monsters
Strengthen Maoh and the monsters by using the Magic Crystals you gain by defeating the enemies.

■Synopsis
Peace returned to Corta Kingdom after the late Maoh, the devil king who once led monsters to conquer the world, was defeated.

One hundred years have passed since then.

It was thought that neither the king nor the monsters had survived.
But in a small Dungeon at the edge of the Corta Islands, the child of the late king, the current Maoh, and his Butler lived.

Maoh “*Smiling*”
Butler "...Munch...”
Butler "Delicious...but I can't face the late king like this…”

Maoh, shy and laid-back, keeps himself in the Dungeon and has no interest in avenging his father or conquering the world.
He loves to cook and is content to offer his food to the Butler.
But one day...

Maoh “!?”
Butler “What the…!”

When Maoh was cooking food in the large pot that his father left, monsters appeared.
As if in response, the royal soldiers appeared in the Dungeon...
